subject: Preflight capacity credit endorsement for Solstice Labs POC
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@solstice.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 8 Jul 2028 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — short window capacity uplift for POC soak

Hey Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the Solstice ML team is good to go on the next round of throughput validation. We have a scheduled overnight soak Saturday->Sunday to validate end-to-end latency at sustained 750 RPS for 6 hours.

Before we kick off, can Redwood provide a short-term credit top-up (trial account) to cover the expected token usage for that window? We estimate ~120K tokens for the run (attached estimate). If possible we need the uplift active by 23:00 PT tonight.

Run details (short):
- Start: 2028-07-09 23:00 PT
- Duration: ~6 hours
- Target steady RPS: 700–800 (burst to 950)
- Payloads: 2–4k tokens per request (real queries)

We can reduce the scope if you need fewer tokens. This is a determinative test for Solstice’s go/no-go decision for a Q3 pilot. Appreciate any runbook pointers as well — we'll loop in our DevOps.

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Head of Platform, Solstice Labs

----
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 8 Jul 2028 18:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — short window capacity uplift for POC soak

Team, forwarding Solstice’s ask — they want a short-term credit top-up to run a night soak that will spike token usage. Attached their usage estimate.

Two quick questions for approvals:
1) Can we provision an ephemeral credit voucher that covers up to 150K tokens for a 12-hour window?
2) Any constraints from infra/finance we should call out (billing, SLA exemption, abuse checks)?

If approved I’ll provision the voucher and confirm exact activation window. This is a high-signal test — Solstice is deciding whether to expand to Dedicated in Q3.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Jul 2028 01:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — short window capacity uplift for POC soak

Marcus — approved.

Marissa here — OK to authorize a one-off promotional credit up to 150,000 tokens for a 12-hour window. Conditions:
- Voucher must auto-expire after 12 hours and be tied to Solstice’s trial account only.
- No refunds; any overage will be billed to the normal trial rate (notify customer).
- Ops should be notified to watch for sustained 900+ RPS; enable fallback policy to smaller model if latency climbs.

Jonas — can you coordinate the runbook and attach the consolidated plan? Stephanie — cc me on the HubSpot note and mark the deal as "POC: credit approved — night soak".

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Sales
Redwood Inference

----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@solstice.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short window capacity uplift for POC soak

Sara — thanks, we’re set.

Attached: poc-run-plan.pdf (runbook) and usage-estimate.csv. Highlights below:
- Voucher: 150,000-token promotional credit, active 2028-07-09T23:00:00-07:00 for 12 hours; automatically revokes at 2028-07-10T11:00:00-07:00.
- Model routing: primary -> rdx-gpt-medium (latency SLO 120ms); fallback -> rdx-gpt-small if 95th p99 > 500ms.
- Autoscaling: temporary burst pool enabled for that account; max concurrent instances capped per contract.
- Logging: audit export for the run uploaded to shared Drive link (see HubSpot deal note).

Please confirm you’ll start at 23:00 PT. I’ll have an engineer on the bridge to watch latency and flip routing if needed.

Jonas Weber
Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: poc-run-plan.pdf (9 pages), usage-estimate.csv (1 KB)

----
From: Sara Patel <sara@solstice.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short window capacity uplift for POC soak

Perfect — we’ll start at 23:00 PT and will loop ops on the bridge. Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the runbook.

Sara
